Sales Quotations (active)
SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM quotations WHERE is_deleted=0
Sales Quotations (all incl. deleted)
SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM quotations
Contracts (active)
SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM contracts WHERE is_deleted=0
Contract units (active)
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(elevator_units,0),1)) v FROM contracts WHERE is_deleted=0
Contract value total (AED)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(contract_value),2) v FROM contracts WHERE is_deleted=0
Client received total (contracts.total_received)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_received),2) v FROM contracts WHERE is_deleted=0
Client balance total (contracts.balance_amount)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(balance_amount),2) v FROM contracts WHERE is_deleted=0
Client payments (rows / received AED)
SELECT COUNT(*) || ' / ' || ROUND(SUM(received_amount),2) v FROM client_payments WHERE is_deleted=0
Factory orders — New Orders (active)
SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM factory_ins_quotes WHERE is_deleted=0
Factory units (New Orders)
SELECT SUM(quantity) v FROM factory_ins_quotes WHERE is_deleted=0
Factory invoice value / paid / balance (New Orders, USD)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(factory_quote_amount),2) || ' / ' || ROUND(SUM(total_paid),2) || ' / ' || ROUND(SUM(balance_payable),2) v FROM factory_ins_quotes WHERE is_deleted=0
OTJ cost / paid / balance
SELECT ROUND(SUM(other_job_cost),2) || ' / ' || ROUND(SUM(total_paid),2) || ' / ' || ROUND(SUM(balance_payable),2) v FROM factory_otj_quotes WHERE is_deleted=0
Sea cost / paid / balance
SELECT ROUND(SUM(sea_cost),2) || ' / ' || ROUND(SUM(total_paid),2) || ' / ' || ROUND(SUM(balance_payable),2) v FROM factory_sea_costs WHERE is_deleted=0
Factory payments (rows / paid)
SELECT COUNT(*) || ' / ' || ROUND(SUM(paid_amount),2) v FROM factory_payments WHERE is_deleted=0
Contract↔Factory links (active)
SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM factory_contract_links WHERE is_deleted=0
FJ-6051 linked contracts
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(contract_ref ORDER BY contract_ref SEPARATOR ',') v FROM factory_contract_links WHERE is_deleted=0 AND factory_ref='FJ-6051'
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(contract_ref, ',') v FROM (SELECT contract_ref FROM factory_contract_links WHERE is_deleted=0 AND factory_ref='FJ-6051' ORDER BY contract_ref)
Maintenance records (active)
SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM maintenance_contracts WHERE is_deleted=0
Maintenance units (active)
SELECT SUM(total_elevator_units) v FROM maintenance_contracts WHERE is_deleted=0
Maintenance schedule months
SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM maintenance_schedule_months
Maintenance visits / sub-visits
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_visits) || ' / ' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_sub_visits) v
Serviced units (sub-visits)
SELECT SUM(units_serviced) v FROM maintenance_sub_visits
AMC renewals (live / all)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM amc_renewals WHERE is_deleted=0) || ' / ' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM amc_renewals) v
AMC value (live renewals)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(new_amc_value),2) v FROM amc_renewals WHERE is_deleted=0
AMC payments ledger (rows / AED)
SELECT COUNT(*) || ' / ' || ROUND(SUM(amount),2) v FROM amc_payment_transactions
AMC collections — valid payments on live renewals (AED)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(t.amount),2) v FROM amc_payment_transactions t JOIN amc_renewals r ON r.id=t.amc_renewal_id AND r.is_deleted=0
AMC outstanding (live Approved renewals)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.new_amc_value - COALESCE(p.s,0) > 0 THEN r.new_amc_value - COALESCE(p.s,0) ELSE 0 END),2) v FROM amc_renewals r LEFT JOIN (SELECT amc_renewal_id, SUM(amount) s FROM amc_payment_transactions GROUP BY amc_renewal_id) p ON p.amc_renewal_id=r.id WHERE r.is_deleted=0 AND r.renewal_status='Approved'
Callbacks
SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM alert_callbacks
Users (all / active)
SELECT COUNT(*) || ' / ' || SUM(active) v FROM users
Users by role (role:count:active)
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(x ORDER BY x SEPARATOR ',') v FROM (SELECT role || ':' || COUNT(*) || ':' || SUM(active) x FROM users GROUP BY role) z
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(x, ',') v FROM (SELECT role || ':' || COUNT(*) || ':' || SUM(active) x FROM users GROUP BY role ORDER BY 1)
Password hashes (username:hash)
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(username || ':' || password_hash ORDER BY id SEPARATOR '|') v FROM users
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(username || ':' || password_hash, '|') v FROM (SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id)
Suppliers
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ',') v FROM suppliers
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name, ',') v FROM (SELECT name FROM suppliers ORDER BY id)
